finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: NPI gives the Barents Sea limits along northern Norway/Russia and east to Novaya Zemlya (L2); NGA places the Kara Sea east of Novaya Zemlya and the Laptev Sea between Severnaya Zemlya and Novosibirsk Islands; NOAA PMEL describes the Chukchi shelf north from Bering Strait. Each alternative is a distinct Arctic sea and only Barents matches the full boundary clue.
